claim: NON-CLAIMING substituted-primitive comparison feeding the DR-0011 proposal: PDK-modelled rsil/rppd/rhigh resistors and cap_cmim/cap_rfcmim MIM capacitors substituted for the generic elements of design/lna_stage1, measured with the lna-sparam-nf method (pinned by sha256) as COMPARATIVE DELTAS ONLY against a same-deck control (the committed ideal-passive DUT) at the bound corners of rows 2, 3, 4 and 6. Inductors stay IDEAL in every variant (#110 / DR-0005). No spec row is claimed met or missed: row 4's own note says S11 is not simulatable as a claim until EM extraction lands, so these deltas are design inputs for the operator's realization call, not compliance evidence.

passive_closure.note: outside the pdk-artifact HBT closure by design; bound to the local install's sha256, cross-recorded in layout/lna_stage1/passive_sizing.json

notes: OFF-CHIP Cblk_in REPRESENTATION (run history): the first collection of this study modelled the off-chip Cblk_in of V01-V03 as an in-band ideal SHORT, which also removed the DC block and collapsed Q1's bias through Lin and Rs1 (deltas of -84 dB in S21 and S11 above 0 dB made the mis-specification obvious). That run was never committed; the corrected representation keeps the designed 1 nF value as an IDEAL element (an off-chip part costs no on-chip area and carries no PDK primitive; the pad/bond/PCB path and the part's own parasitics are NOT modelled -- a stated omission, DR-0011 option c).

V03's large deltas are the measured rfcmim parasitic network, not a failed run: cap_rfcmim's own model carries the plate/feed inductances lplate+lfeed (about 5.5 nH at the 10.6 um Cshunt plate, about 13 nH at the 74.8 um Cblk_in plate with the PDK-default wfeed = 2 um; even the model's largest legal wfeed = 30 um leaves ~9 nH), i.e. over 1 kohm of series reactance in the 19.45 GHz signal path. The PDK's own model therefore rules the primitive out of the Ka-band signal path at these plate sizes -- a decisive DR-0011 input, measured, not asserted.

Substrate parasitics of the large on-chip bodies (rfcmim Cox/Csub/Rsub network, r3_cmc body capacitances) ARE modelled here, through the PDK's own subcircuits instanced in the variant decks; the one omission is the off-chip Cblk_in path of V01/V02 named above.

plan_declaration.baseline_gate: The control's operating points must agree with the post-#79 record's published per-cell op table at every 2.5 V hbt x temperature cell within +-10 mV on V_CE/V_BE and +-2 percent on I_C; S-parameters and NF must sit inside the record's published per-measure min/max envelope. A failure is CONTROLS_FAILED: no variant is ranked and nothing is claimed.

gates.baseline_envelope: control S11/S21/S22/S12/NF/k inside the post-#79 record's published per-measure min/max
gates.baseline_op_table: control vs post-#79 record per-cell op table at the nine 2.5 V hbt x temperature cells: |dV_CE| and |dV_BE| <= 10 mV, |dI_C| <= 2 percent
gates.finite_values: every declared cell of every variant and the control has finite values for every measure of the reused method
gates.passive_inertness: the control's cells at the four passive-extreme processes equal its typ-process cells at the same temperature and supply within 1e-6 relative (the ideal netlist instances no passive device, so the res_*/cap_* sections cannot change it; this is the negative control that proves it)

method.what_is_reused: the whole .control block (analyses + measurement expressions, including the corrected issue-#22 NF method at T0=300.15 K, the 3-point DRAFT-band set, the 1-100 GHz stability sweep and the per-device operating-point let-lines) and the two-port fixture (Thevenin Z0=50 sources, forward/reverse by alterparam+reset), byte-for-byte as the lna-sparam-nf klt body emits them

prematch.output: testbench/prematch.json (committed before the collection; V04's frozen values come from it)
prematch.rule: smallest grid value whose re-matched input holds S11 <= -10 dB at all three DRAFT band points at every declared prematch corner cell; the re-match (Lin, Cshunt) is re-derived per grid value at the band centre from the probed substituted-core base impedance by the L-section method of design/lna_stage1.md

row_bound_cells.row2: hbt_wcs, 125 C, 2.25 V (gain bound corner); delta read at the hbt_wcs process of this axis
row_bound_cells.row4: the four passive-extreme processes (res_* x cap_* cross product) x temperature extremes, hbt_typ
row_bound_cells.row6: the stability sweep minimum across every declared cell (worst process x temp x supply; post-#79's worst k cell was hbt_typ/-40 C/2.75 V)

plan_declaration.scope: NON-CLAIMING substituted-primitive study of design/lna_stage1 feeding the DR-0011 proposal: at most four candidate sets of PDK-modelled resistors (rsil/rppd/rhigh) and MIM capacitors (cap_cmim/cap_rfcmim), compared against a same-deck CONTROL (the committed ideal-passive DUT) as comparative deltas ONLY at the bound corners of ratified rows 2, 3, 4 and 6. Inductors (Lin, Lfeed, Le1) stay IDEAL in every variant and every record (#110 / DR-0005 own them). This plan selects nothing, turns no ratification key, claims no spec row (row 4's own note says S11 is not simulatable as a claim until EM extraction lands), and edits neither the schematic nor the bench it reuses. If a candidate set degrades a ratified row's margin, that is recorded as measured, with the bounded design iteration named that would recover it.

variants.description: rppd bias ladder + rsil RF path + cmim everywhere reachable + Cb2 as two parallel cmim + Cblk_in OFF-CHIP (boundary port, its designed 1 nF value kept as an IDEAL element: no on-chip area, no pad/bond/PCB parasitics -- a stated omission): the mid-sheet-resistor, two-terminal-cap route
rhigh bias ladder (minimum body area, widest res_* corner spread) + the same RF path and capacitors as V01 (Cblk_in likewise off-chip, ideal): isolates the bias-ladder flavour delta against V01

V01's resistors with the rfcmim route for every cap that can take it (substrate nodes admitted) and Cblk_in as an on-chip 1 nF rfcmim parallel array (119 x 74.8 um, ~0.67 mm2 of plate): isolates the cap-primitive and on-chip-Cblk delta against V01

V01 with the SMALLEST on-chip cmim Cblk_in that still closes the input match, re-matched (Lin/Cshunt re-derived at the DRAFT band centre by the design's own L-section method): DR-0011 option (b). The value, side and re-match values are frozen by testbench/prematch.json BEFORE the collection; if no grid value closes, V04 is dropped and the record says so
